rules.text: In zen_pebble_widget_info.xml, declare android:resizeMode="none" and android:widgetFeatures="reconfigurable"; never set resize modes or add configuration_optional.
Strip androidx.startup.InitializationProvider via tools:node="remove" in AndroidManifest.xml.
Store stable serialization codes or specify -keepclassmembers,allowoptimization enum * { <fields>; } in proguard-rules.pro.
Quarantine corrupted raw payloads to items_v1_quarantine and abort backup overwriting whenever item decoding fails.
Wrap all persistence mutations in synchronized(globalStoreLock) and write disk backups via temporary file replacement.
Invoke purgeWidgetBindingsForItem(itemId) across all four configurable widget families inside CountUpStore.deleteItem().
Verify that serialized RemoteViews parcels stay strictly under 40KB via WidgetMemoryBudgetGateTest.
Use explicit size(26.dp) or size(30.dp) on action clusters and apply clip() exclusively to outer card containers.
Maintain <queries> for RecognitionService and RECOGNIZE_SPEECH and delegate audio capture out-of-process via RecognizerIntent.
Validate appWidgetId != INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID, verify caller identity, and return results containing only EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID.
Invoke MidnightAlarmReceiver.scheduleMidnightAlarm(context) with RTC_WAKEUP inside widget onUpdate() and onEnabled().

Never run an aggressive orphaned-binding purge on app startup. Implement onRestored(oldIds, newIds) on all AppWidgetProvider classes delegating to CountUpStore.remapWidgetBindings, and restrict deletion to onDeleted() or deleteItem().
Compute next midnight using now.toLocalDate().plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(now.zone).plusSeconds(1).toInstant().toEpochMilli() to safely cross DST boundaries, and register ACTION_MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED.

Use FileOutputStream.fd.sync() paired with java.nio.file.Files.move(tempPath, targetPath, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING) for robust atomic file snapshots across both Android and desktop unit test environments.
In centered responsive layouts, apply .widthIn(max = 640.dp) before .fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight() to ensure constraints scale correctly on foldables and tablets.
Declare both previewLayout and previewImage, populating layout XMLs with default localized strings and preview tracks to deliver authentic living dual-locale (EN/ZH) previews in pickers.

Never call window.setStatusBarColor() or window.setNavigationBarColor(); set layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = ALWAYS on API 28+, isNavigationBarContrastEnforced = false on API 29+, and manage bar contrast dynamically via WindowCompat.getInsetsController for Android 15 edge-to-edge compliance.

Always set a unique data URI (intent.data = Uri.parse("countup://widget/overview/$appWidgetId")) on any service intent passed to views.setRemoteAdapter() when multiple widget instances display instance-specific collections.
Write automated contract invariant tests (WidgetContractInvariantsTest.kt) that parse and validate XML files directly, turning written guidelines into executable red/green assertions in CI.
Use defensive bounds checking (rows.getOrNull(position)) in RemoteViewsFactory to avoid IndexOutOfBoundsException during asynchronous launcher scroll races.

Default modal option toggles to calm OFF (showInWidget = true / isHiddenFromWidget = false) for exclusion overrides, mirroring the active override with quiet micro-indicators (ic_widget_off, 11dp, 50-55% alpha) on compact card surfaces.

In circular glanceable widgets, unify the visual path into a single generous orbit track (8dp-proportional gauge) with the cadence milestone nestled directly on the track. Strip container backgrounds and borders from secondary milestone labels, rendering them as quiet, unboxed whispers without negative deficit math.
Always reuse the canonical ItemCard composable in widget configure activities with no-op delete/reset handlers and TextHandleMove haptics instead of introducing bespoke card selection rows.

risk_areas.why: Central build and signing configuration; frequent version bumps and multi-tier credential resolution.
Primary Compose UI screen containing action clusters, dialog triggers, and responsive layout scaling.
Storage engine handling concurrent shared preferences, atomic backup files, and corrupted payload quarantine.
Primary widget broadcast receiver handling daily midnight rollovers and interactive counter resets.
1x1 widget XML descriptor subject to OEM slot-0 snapping and configuration_optional suppression traps.
Application manifest enforcing zero permissions via tools:node="remove" and package queries.

checklist.text: Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest to verify all 445 existing unit and contract tests pass.
Confirm the tree is clean: git status --porcelain.
Read docs/RECURRING_ISSUES.md before touching any widget provider or XML layout.
Maintain zero runtime permissions; never add RECORD_AUDIO or RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED to AndroidManifest.xml.
Preserve android:resizeMode="none" and reconfigurable in zen_pebble_widget_info.xml; never add configuration_optional.
Omit Modifier.minimumInteractiveComponentSize() from 26dp subheader and 30dp card action button clusters.
Wrap all CountUpStore mutations in synchronized(globalStoreLock) and invoke purgeWidgetBindingsForItem(itemId) on deletion.
Run ./gradlew assembleRelease to confirm R8 rules preserve all data models, enums, and widget providers.
Verify widget RemoteViews payload remains below 40KB via WidgetMemoryBudgetGateTest.
